tasks.title: Fix a defect in the casts work (this repo, project root): app/Models/HumanResources/DepartmentPivot.php has a protected $casts block containing 'group_id' => 'integer', but the live DB column (verified via SHOW COLUMNS FROM pivot_dept_cate_branches on ipmaerp) is department_id, NOT group_id - group_id does not exist and was invented by an earlier agent. Fix: in the $casts block, replace the line 'group_id' => 'integer', with 'department_id' => 'integer', (keep the rest of the block exactly as is). Verify: php -l app/Models/HumanResources/DepartmentPivot.php must report No syntax errors, and grep must show 'department_id' => 'integer' present and no 'group_id' line. Do not touch anything else in the file. Report the changed line and the php -l result.

Build HttpJsonRpcTransport - real A2A over HTTP JSON-RPC (this repo, ai-multiagents subproject). Context: ai-multiagents/src/message_bus.py defines the OmnirouteTransport interface with the LocalBusTransport (in-process + SQLite outbox) implementation. docs/04-communication-a2a.md section 8 specifies HttpJsonRpcTransport as the future real A2A over HTTP JSON-RPC (Agent Cards, message/send, task/get, task/cancel) that must be swappable WITHOUT touching agent adapters. Create a new file ai-multiagents/src/http_transport.py implementing class HttpJsonRpcTransport(OmnirouteTransport) that imports AgentCard, make_message, RoutingError from .message_bus and mirrors the LocalBusTransport public API exactly: register_agent, unregister_agent, get_card, list_cards, update_status, emit_status, send, capability_route, undelivered. Design: (1) HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 server side using ONLY the Python standard library (http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer + json) - no new dependencies beyond the existing PyYAML; the server listens on a configurable host/port (defaults 127.0.0.1:47500), serves an HTTP POST /rpc endpoint that dispatches JSON-RPC methods: message/send (delivers an A2A envelope to a registered local handler, enforcing no-double-dispatch on task messages exactly like LocalBusTransport, persisting to the same SQLite outbox at ai-multiagents/memory/bus.db with dedupe by messageId), task/get (return task status/result), task/cancel (mark a task canceled), card/get (agent card by id), card/list (all cards); (2) client side: send(message) resolves recipients (named to / toCapability / broadcast per the same _resolve_recipients logic) and POSTs each envelope to the remote agent endpoint as JSON-RPC message/send, honoring RoutingError on no-double-dispatch; (3) keep the SQLite outbox semantics (at-least-once, INSERT OR IGNORE dedupe) by reusing the same outbox table; (4) the remote endpoint for each agent comes from a registry mapping agent_id to base URL (defaults to a single local server URL; agents register their own URL via register_agent). Match the existing code style in message_bus.py (type hints, docstrings). Do not modify message_bus.py's existing LocalBusTransport behavior - only add the new class in the new file. Verify: python -m py_compile ai-multiagents/src/http_transport.py, and write a quick self-test that starts the HTTP server on an ephemeral port, registers a fake handler, sends a message/send JSON-RPC request via urllib, and confirms the handler receives the envelope - run it and paste the result.

Wire transport selection + smoke test the HTTP A2A transport (this repo, ai-multiagents subproject). Steps: (1) in ai-multiagents/src/orchestrator.py, replace the hardcoded `self.bus = LocalBusTransport(capability_map=build_capability_map(self.roles))` with transport selection driven by an environment variable MESH_TRANSPORT (values: local = default, http): when MESH_TRANSPORT=http, construct HttpJsonRpcTransport from ai-multiagents/src/http_transport.py (with the same capability_map and the default 127.0.0.1:47500 host/port), else LocalBusTransport - keep the rest of orchestrator.boot unchanged so agent adapters are untouched (swap-in without touching adapters is the A2A requirement); (2) run the existing smoke suites to prove nothing regressed: ai-multiagents/smoke_bus.py, ai-multiagents/smoke_coordinator.py, ai-multiagents/smoke_manual_coordinator.py - all must pass; (3) run a live HTTP A2A round-trip: start the mesh with MESH_TRANSPORT=http (one-shot python -c boot of Orchestrator is fine), confirm both agent cards register over HTTP, then send a small A2A task message via the HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint and confirm it reaches an agent handler; capture the JSON-RPC request/response pair and the delivered envelope in your report. Report each step's exact output, any failures, and the final working proof that the mesh speaks A2A over HTTP JSON-RPC.

tasks.title: Update the A2A documentation (this repo, ai-multiagents subproject): edit ai-multiagents/docs/04-communication-a2a.md section 8 to reflect that HttpJsonRpcTransport is now BUILT (not future): document the HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 surface (POST /rpc with methods message/send, task/get, task/cancel, card/get, card/list), the default endpoint 127.0.0.1:47500, the MESH_TRANSPORT=local|http environment switch in orchestrator, and that agent adapters remain untouched by the transport swap. Also update ai-multiagents/docs/06-implementation-plan.md line ~40 and ai-multiagents/docs/01-architecture.md ADR-2 row to mark HttpJsonRpcTransport as implemented with a date (2026-08-17). Do not invent details - only document what the transport actually does per the implementation and the verification results from the tester. Report the exact lines edited in each doc file.
